description: How did calls to the CourseShelf box perform? From the box's call log: each call that reached the box, newest first, with its time (at), tool, outcome (answered; stopped by the query budget; busy, no slot free; invalid_params; error; not_pinned), ms from the slot being taken to the answer, the build that answered, and the stated error text where there is one; per tool, the count of each outcome; and the log files read. Arguments are logged for the catalog services only. An empty window is said so.

from.description: Optional ISO time the window starts (default 24 hours before 'to')

limit.description: Optional page size (default 200); the answer-size budget may trim it further and says so

min_ms.description: Optional: only the calls that took at least this many ms

outcome.description: Optional: only the calls with this outcome

to.description: Optional ISO time the window ends (default now)

tool.description: Optional: only the calls of this tool

name: get_courseshelf_performance
title: CourseShelf Performance
